about.title: About Me
about.description: I am a Full Stack developer focused on creating modern, efficient, and scalable web solutions. I have practical experience with technologies such as React, Node.js, SQL, and NoSQL, which allows me to design and implement robust end-to-end applications. I am a Computer Systems Engineer with a specialization in Software Engineering, and I am certified by Google in Cybersecurity, which gives me a comprehensive vision of building secure, reliable, and high-performance systems. I am passionate about technological innovation, continuous improvement, and developing products that provide real value.
